desc: 六分钟首批子弹冰，日产数十磅，整篮可取自清洁，夜低噪户外也能带
name: 六分钟子弹冰台式制冰机款

shots.intent: 第一眼建立即产即饮欲望：掀盖满冰加双饮品
把出冰速度可视化：镀铬冰架挂冰加时钟环
一键操作的零学习成本：指示灯语放大可读
消除吵不吵的顾虑：入睡人物与运行机器同框
整篮可取外带：倒冰不脏手、随取随移
便携把手变社交货币：家庭户外餐桌的产冰中枢
一杯两档按需选择：小冰快饮大冰慢化
色选与产量气势：冰瀑倾泻加饮品飞溅
免拆洗安心：半透明机身内水路发光循环
量化收口：超大数字钉死产能规格

style.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for hero and variant; vertical ice-blue gradient #E9F1FC to #AAC3E1 for mechanism and spec frames, spec cards may deepen to #91B5D6; real environments for scenes
style.direction: instant-ice countertop appliance suite: white studio product truth plus ice-blue infographic system plus warm outdoor scenes, pain-first and spec-locked
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons, clock-dial ring for duration, dashed dimension callouts, three-column spec rows, round LED status legend chips
style.lightingSystem: large top-front softbox with faint contact shadows for product; hard midday sun for outdoor; low ambient cool light with soft falloff for night; internal glow allowed only for water path and indicator LEDs
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: countertop bullet-ice maker e-commerce suite. Bright white studio hero with a filled ice basket and iced drinks; mechanism and spec frames sit on a vertical ice-blue gradient #E9F1FC to #AAC3E1 carrying bold uppercase headlines, oversized numerals, thin-line icons, clock-dial rings and dashed dimension callouts; the glossy black body #1E1E1E stays constant with a teal variant #7FB3B2 allowed and orange drink accents #F47004 for appetite appeal. Lighting is a large top-front softbox with faint contact shadows; outdoor scenes run hard golden-hour sun, the night scene runs muted blue-gray ambient for the low-noise story. One claim per frame, ice always visible, hands only in demos, no fabricated ranking badges or output figures - numbers come from the product facts only.
noDrift: no fourth primary color outside the palette
no cube or crescent ice shapes, bullet ice only
no fabricated ranking badges or sales figures
no other appliance models mixed in
no horizontal gradients, ice-blue vertical only
style.presentationRules: product occupies 45-60% in product frames and 15-25% in scene frames but always the anchor; ice visible in every frame; hands only in demonstration frames; graphics never covering the product; dark body needs rim separation on dark grounds
style.surfaceSystem: matte white acrylic counter or light-gray #E7E7E7 photo table; scenes use white wood tables, stone counters, RV camp tables; body stays glossy black or teal lacquer
style.temperature: icy neutral for studio and infographic frames, warm golden for outdoor scenes, muted cool for the night frame
style.typography: bold geometric uppercase benefit headlines, oversized numerals, dark charcoal on light grounds and white on gradient cards, one claim per frame
